turns.content: Write z=r e^{i theta} with r>0. Express the area of the parallelogram spanned by z and 1/z in terms of theta, and use the given area 35/37 to obtain an exact trigonometric constraint.
Use that constraint to determine all possible values of cos(2 theta).
Express |z+1/z|^2 in terms of r and cos(2 theta), and minimize the radial part over r>0 for a fixed angular branch.
Using the area value 35/37, determine which angular branches are compatible with Re(z)>0, and state when equality holds in the radial minimization.
Compare the two possible values of cos(2 theta) in the minimized expression and identify which branch gives the smaller value.
Verify the selected branch directly with sin^2(2 theta)+cos^2(2 theta)=1 and the condition Re(z)>0.
Compute the smallest possible value d of |z+1/z| and give d^2 exactly.
